prompt: Which of these can trigger a GitHub Actions workflow?
explanation: Workflows hook into a long list of events — pushes, pull requests, schedules, releases, issues, and more — plus manual dispatch. Restricting triggers to pushes is a choice a workflow makes, not a limit of the platform.

options.text: A push, a pull request, a schedule, or the publication of a release
Only pushes to the default branch
Only manual runs started by an administrator
Any edit made in the GitHub UI
